node.title: Booking Management – API Testing
node.description: Validation of RESTful Booker API endpoints, covering authentication, booking creation, update, and deletion workflows. Includes positive, negative, and edge case scenarios to ensure reliability and data integrity.

node.title: [GET] Health - Ping
node.description: Verify that the API is up and running.

node.expected_result: 1. Status Code 201 Created. 2. Response time is below 1000ms.

node.title: [POST] Auth - CreateToken
node.description: Verify that the system generates a valid authentication token when correct admin credentials are provided. This token is required for PUT and DELETE operations.
node.postconditions: The 'token' environment variable is updated with the new value.

node.expected_result: 1\. Status code is 200 OK\. 2\. Response body contains a valid "token" string \(length \> 0\)\. 3\. Token is successfully saved to the "token" environment variable\.

node.title: [POST] Booking - CreateBooking
node.description: Verify that a new booking can be created using a valid JSON payload. The system must return the created booking object and a unique Booking ID.
node.postconditions: The 'bookingId' environment variable is captured and updated for future use.

node.expected_result: 1\. Status code is 200 OK\. 2\. Response body contains a unique "bookingid" \(number\)\. 3\. Validated Data: "firstname" is "Marcie" and "depositpaid" is true\. 4\. "bookingid" is successfully saved to environment variables\.

node.title: [GET] Booking - GetBookingById
node.description: Verify that specific booking details can be retrieved using a valid Booking ID. Ensures data consistency with the created record.
node.preconditions: Requires a valid 'bookingId' stored in environment variables (from CreateBooking step).

node.expected_result: 1\. Status code is 200 OK\. 2\. Data Consistency: "firstname" is "Marcie" and "lastname" is "Jimenez"\. 3\. Date Validation: Checkin date matches YYYY\-MM\-DD format \(Regex\)\. 4\. Type Validation: "totalprice" is a valid number\.

node.title: [PUT] Booking - UpdateBooking
node.description: Verify that an existing booking can be fully updated. This operation requires a valid Auth Token.
node.preconditions: 1. Valid 'bookingId' exists 2. Valid 'token' exists (generated in Auth step).

node.expected_result: 1\. Status code is 200 OK\. 2\. Update Verified: "totalprice" is 200 and "additionalneeds" is "Full Update Test"\. 3\. Persistence Verified: "firstname" remains "Marcie"\.

node.title: [PATCH] Booking - PartialUpdateBooking
node.description: Verify that specific fields of an existing booking can be updated without affecting the rest of the data. Includes a regression check on unchanged fields.
node.preconditions: 1. Valid 'bookingId' exists. 2. Valid 'token' exists (required for authorization).

node.expected_result: 1\. Status code is 200 OK\. 2\. Patched Fields: "firstname" is "Marcie QA"\, "lastname" is "Jimenez Master"\. 3\. Regression Check: "totalprice" remains 200 \(unchanged from previous state\)\.

node.title: GET] Booking - GetBookingIdsByFilter
node.description: Verify that the system returns the correct Booking IDs when filtering by "firstname" and "lastname".
node.preconditions: A booking with Firstname="Marcie QA" and Lastname="Jimenez Master" must exist (created/updated in previous steps).

node.action: Send GET request to {{baseUrl}}/booking?firstname=Marcie QA&lastname=Jimenez Master
node.expected_result: 1\. Status code is 200 OK\. 2\. Search Validation: Response is an Array with at least one item \(length \> 0\)\. 3\. Structure Check: The found item contains a "bookingid"\.

node.title: [DELETE] Booking - DeleteBooking
node.description: Verify that an existing booking can be deleted permanently. This operation requires a valid Auth Token.
node.preconditions: 1. Valid 'bookingId' exists (to be deleted). 2. Valid 'token' exists (required for authorization).
node.postconditions: The specific bookingId is invalidated/removed from the system.

node.action:
Send DELETE request to {{baseUrl}}/booking/{{bookingId}}
Header: Cookie: token={{token}}
node.expected_result: 1\. Status code is 201 Created\. 2\. Response Body: Text equals "Created"\. 3\. Performance: Response time is below 1000ms\.

node.title: Trello Framework – API Workflow Testing
node.description: Testing Trello API workflows with chained requests, focusing on board, list, and card management. Includes data validation and error handling scenarios.

node.title: [GET] Auth - Check Credentials
node.description: Verify that the API Key and Token are valid and allow access to the user's account.
node.preconditions: Valid 'key' and 'token' must be configured in the environment variables.

node.expected_result: 1\. Status code is 200 OK\. 2\. Response contains User ID and Username\. 3\. Performance: Response time < 1000ms\.

node.title: [POST] Boards - CreateBoard
node.description: Verify that a new board can be created. The system must return a unique Board ID, which is captured for subsequent tests.
node.postconditions: The 'boardId' environment variable is updated with the new Board ID.

node.expected_result: 1\. Status code is 200 OK\. 2\. Response body contains a valid "id"\. 3\. Automation: "boardId" is successfully saved to environment variables\.

node.title: [POST] Lists - CreateList
node.description: Verify that a new list (e.g., "To Do") can be created on the previously created board. Captures the List ID for adding cards.
node.preconditions: 1. Valid 'boardId' exists (from CreateBoard step). 2. Valid 'key' and 'token' are configured.
node.postconditions: The 'listId' environment variable is updated with the new List ID.

node.expected_result: 1\. Status code is 200 OK\. 2\. Response body contains a valid "id"\. 3\. Automation: "listId" is successfully saved to environment variables\.

node.title: [POST] Cards - CreateCard
node.description: Verify that a new card can be created within a specific list. Includes performance checks and data integrity validation.
node.preconditions: 1. Valid 'listId' exists (from CreateList step). 2. Valid 'key' and 'token' are configured.
node.postconditions: The 'cardId' environment variable is updated for future operations.

node.action: Send POST request to {{baseUrl}}/cards?idList={{listId}}&name=My First Automated Card&key={{key}}&token={{token}}
node.expected_result: 1\. Status code is 200 OK\. 2\. Performance: Response time is below 800ms\. 3\. Data Integrity: "name" equals "My First Automated Card"\. 4\. Structure: Response contains a valid "id"\. 5\. Safety Check: Response does not contain "error" property\. 6\. Automation: "cardId" is successfully saved\.

node.title: [PUT] Cards - UpdateCard
node.description: Verify that an existing card can be updated (description and position). Includes regression checks to ensure the Card ID remains unchanged.
node.preconditions: 1. Valid 'cardId' exists. 2. Valid 'key' and 'token' are configured.

node.action: Send PUT request to {{baseUrl}}/cards/{{cardId}}?desc=Updated description via API&pos=top&key={{key}}&token={{token}}
node.expected_result: 1\. Status code is 200 OK\. 2\. Data Validation: "desc" is updated to "Updated description via API"\. 3\. Position check: "pos" is not null\. 4\. Immutability Check: "id" matches the known \{\{cardId\}\}\. 5\. Safety: Response does not contain "error"\.

node.title: [GET] Cards - GetCard
node.description: Verify that card details can be retrieved. Ensures data persistence by validating that the description matches the previously updated value.
node.preconditions: 1. Valid 'cardId' exists. 2. Valid 'key' and 'token' are configured.

node.expected_result: 1\. Status code is 200 OK\. 2\. Data Persistence: "desc" equals "Updated description via API"\. 3\. Structure Check: Response contains "id" and "name"\. 4\. Data Validation: "name" is not empty\.

node.title: [POST] Cards - AddComment
node.description: Verify that a comment can be added to a specific card. Validates the nested response structure to ensure the text and creator details are correct.
node.preconditions: 1. Valid 'cardId' exists. 2. Valid 'key' and 'token' are configured.

node.action: Send POST request to {{baseUrl}}/cards/{{cardId}}/actions/comments?text=Automation testing is fun!&key={{key}}&token={{token}}
node.expected_result: 1\. Status code is 200 OK\. 2\. Content Verification: "data\.text" matches "Automation testing is fun\!"\. 3\. User Verification: "idMemberCreator" is not null\. 4\. Structure: Response contains a valid "id"\. 5\. Sanity Check: Object is not marked as "deleted"\.

node.title: [POST] Checklists - CreateChecklist
node.description: Verify that a checklist can be added to a card. Validates the name, the association with the parent card, and that it is initially empty.
node.preconditions: 1. Valid 'cardId' exists. 2. Valid 'key' and 'token' are configured.

node.expected_result: 1\. Status code is 200 OK\. 2\. Data Verification: "name" equals "QA Tasks"\. 3\. Relationship Check: "idCard" matches the environment variable \{\{cardId\}\}\. 4\. Initial State: "checkItems" is an empty array\.

node.title: [DELETE] Cards - DeleteCard
node.description: Verify that a specific card can be deleted individually using its ID.
node.preconditions: 1. Valid 'cardId' exists 2. Valid 'key' and 'token' are configured.
node.postconditions: The specific card is removed from the board.

node.expected_result: 1\. Status code is 200 OK\. 2\. Operation Check: Response confirms successful deletion \(Body is OK/Null\)\. 3\. Performance: Response time is below 800ms\.

node.title: [DELETE] Boards - DeleteBoard
node.description: Verify that the board is permanently deleted. This action cascades and removes all lists and cards contained within.
node.preconditions: 1. Valid 'boardId' exists. 2. Valid 'key' and 'token' are configured.
node.postconditions: The Board and all its contents are removed from the account.

node.expected_result: 1\. Status code is 200 OK\. 2\. Response Validation: Body contains property "_value"\. 3\. Performance: Response time is below 2000ms\.
